resources.string: On keeps the current behavior. Off disables only early boundary retargeting; deliberate slide selection and release-to-submit stay the same. Switch between both modes for the comparison.

Off by default. Records touch coordinates, contact area, pressure, key changes and emitted key actions. Ordinary text fields only; excludes passwords, email addresses, URLs and private fields. Local storage only, up to 2 MiB, retained for seven days. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
